content.statementText: B completed twice as many tiles as A.

content.correctedText: B completed 90 tiles; A completed 80. B completed 10 more tiles, or 9/8 as many.
content.debrief: The original headline is false: 90 is not twice 80. Subtracting a baseline of 70 produces lengths 10 and 20, whose ratio is 2. Those lengths are offsets, not completed counts. The corrected chart starts at zero and preserves the original source. This authored example does not show that a person was persuaded.

content.correctedText: B completed 10 tiles; A completed 0. B completed 10 more tiles. A multiplicative ratio B/A is undefined.
content.debrief: The original headline is false: 10 is not twice 0. B/A and the bar-length ratio have a zero denominator; neither is a finite multiplicative factor. The counts and their difference remain exactly known. Correct the statement without inventing a percentage, infinity value or positive A bar.
